entry.name: Drampa Mega
entry.flavorEs: Es de naturaleza mansa y amable, pero, si se enfurece, puede desatar fuertes vientos capaces de llevarse cualquier cosa por delante.
entry.flavorZh: 心地善良爱亲近人， 但只要生气就会 刮起强风吹倒一切。

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.
abilities.textEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
abilities.detailEs: Siempre que este Pokémon recibe daño de un movimiento que hace que sus PS caigan por debajo del 50%, su Ataque Especial sube un nivel.
abilities.detailZh: 每当此宝可梦因招式受到伤害而导致HP降至50%以下时，其特攻提升一个等级。
abilities.detailPt: Sempre que este Pokémon sofre dano de um movimento que faz seu HP cair abaixo de 50%, seu Ataque Especial sobe um estágio.
